title: Enhancing Industrial Hemp (Cannabis sativa) Leaf By-Products: Bioactive Compounds, Anti-Inflammatory Properties, and Potential Health Applications.
authors: Frusciante, Luisa; Geminiani, Michela; Shabab, Behnaz; Olmastroni, Tommaso; Roncucci, Neri; Mastroeni, Pierfrancesco; Salvini, Laura; Lamponi, Stefania; Trezza, Alfonso; Santucci, Annalisa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究工业大麻叶提取物的抗炎活性与代谢物鉴定，涉及MAPK/NF-κB信号通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The sustainable utilization of biomass-derived bioactives addresses the growing demand for natural health products and supports sustainable development goals by reducing reliance on synthetic chemicals in healthcare. Cannabis sativa biomass, in particular, has emerged as a valuable resource within this context. This study focuses on the hydroethanolic extract of C. sativa leaves (CSE), which exhibited significant levels of phenolic compounds contributing to robust antioxidant activity. Evaluation using potassium ferricyanide, ABTS, and DPPH methods revealed potent radical scavenging activity comparable to the Trolox standard. UPLC-MS/MS profiling identified cannabinoids as the predominant secondary metabolites in CSE, with flavonoids also present in substantial quantities. This study investigated the anti-inflammatory potential of CSE on RAW 264.7 macrophages and IL-1beta-stimulated C-20/A4 immortalized human chondrocytes, demonstrating protective effects without cytotoxic or mutagenic effects. Mechanistically, CSE reduced inflammation by inhibiting the MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. In silico approaches showed the ability of CSE's main metabolites to bind and influence MAPK and NF-kappaB activity, confirming in vitro evidence. Incorporating C. sativa leaf extract into a hyaluronic acid-based formulation showed biotechnological promise for treating joint inflammation. Future research should aim to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying these effects and explore the potential of CSE-derived compounds in mitigating osteoarthritis progression. This approach highlights the significance of utilizing annually increasing biomass waste for sustainable bioactivity and environmental impact reduction.
abstract_zh: 生物质来源的生物活性物质的可持续利用，满足了人们对天然健康产品日益增长的需求，并通过减少医疗保健中对合成化学品的依赖，支持可持续发展目标。在此背景下，大麻（Cannabis sativa）生物质尤其已成为一种宝贵资源。本研究聚焦于大麻叶的水乙醇提取物（CSE），其表现出显著水平的酚类化合物，有助于强大的抗氧化活性。通过铁氰化钾、ABTS和DPPH方法评估，显示出与Trolox标准相当的强效自由基清除活性。UPLC-MS/MS分析鉴定出大麻素（cannabinoids）为CSE中的主要次生代谢物，同时黄酮类化合物也以可观数量存在。本研究探讨了CSE对RAW 264.7巨噬细胞和IL-1β刺激的C-20/A4永生化人软骨细胞的抗炎潜力，证明其具有保护作用，且无细胞毒性或致突变效应。机制上，CSE通过抑制MAPK和NF-κB信号通路来减少炎症。计算机模拟方法显示，CSE主要代谢物能够结合并影响MAPK和NF-κB活性，证实了体外证据。将大麻叶提取物纳入基于透明质酸的制剂中，显示出治疗关节炎症的生物技术前景。未来研究应旨在阐明这些效应背后的分子机制，并探索CSE衍生化合物在缓解骨关节炎进展中的潜力。该方法强调了利用逐年增加的生物质废弃物实现可持续生物活性和减少环境影响的重大意义。
